name: reachability-analysis-test-a8532630b8/unreachability_test2-e.bal
spec_references: ## Statements: Match statement — Currently only supports const-pattern and wildcard-match-pattern
## Statements: supported statement list includes Return, Panic, If/else, While and Lock statement, but does not include fail, do or on fail
## Expressions: Query expressions — Supports `from`, `where`, `let`, `join` (including outer join), `order by`, `limit`, `on conflict` and `select` clauses; Supports `group by` and `collect` clauses
reason: The whole negative test asserts unreachable-code diagnostics across both supported control flow and essential unsupported constructs. In particular, reachability inside guarded `var a` match patterns exceeds the explicit const/wildcard-only match restriction. Query-action do bodies and fail/do/on-fail control flow also exceed the positive lists, so the complete case is a feature request.
unsupported_constructs: Binding match patterns with guards: `var a if a is int` and `var x if a > 10`
Query actions ending in `do` blocks, with reachability inferred from where clauses
fail statements and do/on-fail control flow
test_design_notes: The @error annotations assert compile-time rejection for unreachable code; negative status alone does not make supported portions out of scope.
Commented-out TODO cases are not assessed as active constructs.
